turnover_source_metadata.cap_rule: prior native H1 quote turnover / 60 minutes; must be >= 1e-6 USDT per minute

causality.decision_ms: entry_ms == confirmed native UTC 12H close; original V1.7 signal is already finalized at this boundary
causality.feature_h1_open_ms: entry_ms - 3h, entry_ms - 2h, entry_ms - 1h exactly; each close occurs no later than entry_ms
causality.entry_price_clock: H1 open at entry_ms, cross-checked against frozen path entry_price; this row is excluded from H1 close features

control_definition: all_observable is the no-gate baseline/control; the queue source has actual V1.7 entries only, not separate matched non-signal rows.
native_vectorbt: Conditional cohorts use cloud_close_liquid_queue.main -> actual shared-cash VectorBT portfolio; this builder contains no fill/PnL engine.
limitations: No funding or exit-depth model; the source account uses the preregistered 10% prior-hour average-volume cap.
